subject: prd/incident-machinery
statement: When invoked as `add-incident` with a date, a tag list, and the four field values, the writer shall append a conformant entry to the registry at its configured path under the next dense `I<n>` ID — allocation is code, never prompted — and shall refuse the write, changing nothing, if the resulting registry would fail `lint-incidents`.
rationale: INV-35's "one coded writer; ID allocation is code" becomes real
fit_criterion: on a fixture registry ending at I3, `add-incident` writes I4 passing lint; a second call allocates I5; a write that would fail lint (e.g. empty tags) is refused naming the lint defect and the registry is byte-unchanged
